payload.title: Suggest an edit (replaces public edit controls)
payload.description:
As a reader, I want to suggest a correction to a wiki page, so that errors reach the desk without public editing.

Uses the existing public form endpoint (stores a private message for the desk). Shows "Updated DATE" and a link to the entity's graph JSON.

```gherkin
Feature: Suggest an edit
  Scenario: Submit a suggestion
    When a reader submits a suggestion on a page
    Then the desk receives a message that names the page
    And nothing changes on the public page
```
